title: kit.regex-linear.v1
description: The reviewed list of regular expressions that may stay in code outside packages/uploads/src because they are linear or never see attacker bytes (packages/uploads/test/regex-linear.json, read by the ReDoS gate). One entry per regex: the file, the pattern as the parser reads it, optionally the enclosing function (`in`), and the reason it is safe. The gate fails on an entry whose regex is gone.

in.description: Optional: the enclosing function the regex is in. When present the entry covers only that function, not the whole file.
